Afghan Girls Access Secret Education Amid Taliban Restrictions

In Afghanistan, women and girls are circumventing severe Taliban restrictions on education by attending secret, virtual classes. These initiatives aim to provide educational opportunities despite the de facto authorities' bans on girls' and women's access to schooling. The clandestine schools represent a form of resistance against the strict limitations imposed on women's lives and public participation since the Taliban's return to power.
